name: Notubiz Agenda Item to decidesk AgendaItem
description: Maps a Notubiz agenda_item (RIS agenda item) onto decidesk's ORI-aligned AgendaItem schema. itemType is inferred from the Notubiz item type. orderNumber comes from the Notubiz order/sortorder field.

mapping.title: {{ values.title ?? values.name ?? values.subject }}
mapping.itemType: {% set t = (values.type ?? '')|lower %}{% if t == 'discussion' or t == 'bespreekstuk' %}discussion{% elseif t == 'decision' or t == 'besluit' or t == 'hamerstuk' %}decision{% else %}informational{% endif %}
